pages.title: Jade Resonance
pages.text: The Ancient Jade is granted on first spawn. Carry it at stage zero until it resonates; after awakening, right-click it to read this book. Normal play does not lower stages one through six.
If it is lost, craft another from a book, emerald, Spirit Crystal and Immortal Power.

Suggested route: gather aura, brew the current pill, expand Kongqiao, satisfy the special stage-five ascension, enter your personal realm, then complete tribulations there. All keybinds are configurable.
